The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8080` (see `KeycloakBuilder.KeycloakPort`)
- Port: `9000` (see `KeycloakBuilder.KeycloakHealthPort`)
- Environment variable: `KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME=admin` (see `KeycloakBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `KEYCLOAK_ADMIN=admin` (see `KeycloakBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin` (see `KeycloakBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Environment variable: `KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin` (see `KeycloakBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Environment variable: `KC_HEALTH_ENABLED=true`
- Command: `start-dev`
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `Added user '[^']+' to realm '[^']+'|Created temporary admin user with username \S+` is logged.
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /health/ready` to port `8080` is completed successfully.

The configuration depends on the image. The list applies to `quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:21.1.2`.
